items.name: not-found-001
items.title: Страница не найдена
items.description: Импульс запроса бежит по маршруту в барьер перед крупным статус-кодом: при ударе барьер вспыхивает, а цифры вздрагивают.
items.docs: Компонент самодостаточен: один файл, ноль зависимостей, палитра в локальных --vibeui-not-found-001-*. Тему берёт из окружения через light-dark() плюс строку для класса .dark. Импульс движется по прямой через offset-path (как в connections-001) от края до барьера, гаснет вспышкой о барьер, а статус-код за барьером вздрагивает в тот же момент — все три анимации делят одну переменную --vibeui-not-found-001-duration, поэтому фазы совпадают без JS.

en.title: Not Found
en.description: A request spike traveling a route into a barrier at a large status code: the barrier flashes on impact and the digits shake.
en.docs: The component is self-contained: one file, zero dependencies, palette in local --vibeui-not-found-001-* variables. It takes the theme from the environment via light-dark() plus a rule for the .dark class. The pulse travels a straight line via offset-path (like connections-001) from the edge to the barrier, fades out in a burst on impact, and the status code behind the barrier shakes at the same moment — all three animations share the --vibeui-not-found-001-duration variable, so the phases stay in sync without JS.

ai.summary: Not found: a request pulse travels a route into a barrier at a large status code, the code shakes on impact. Zero dependencies, one file, no client JS.
preserve: the local --vibeui-not-found-001-* palette — do not swap it for your theme tokens
the pulse traveling the route into the barrier and the impact burst — the category's signature animation
the shake of the large status code at the moment of impact
the dashed route line and the translucent barrier
the .dark class rule: without it the component stays light on a dark page in another project
adapt: the title and status via the title and status props
the status code via the code prop
the pulse and burst accent color via the accent prop
the run speed via the duration prop (seconds per cycle), pausing via paused
notes: the pulse, burst and code shake share --vibeui-not-found-001-duration — phases stay in sync without JS
duration changes the CSS variable all animation lengths are computed from
